added.summary: A light a cell spawns (og.PointLight, og.SpotLight, og.RectLight) no longer switches on whole on the cell's load tick: its intensity ramps over the same fade as the cell's models (0.4 s by default, held and started with them). og.render.reveal on the light or its cell sets the length; 0 lights it at once. Presentation only: world state and hashes are unchanged; og.loading.idle waits for the ramp.
